sources.title: SparkLLM/Spark-X2.5-1.7B
sources.snippet: Spark-X2.5 is a compact, general-purpose language model for conversation, writing, translation, reasoning, coding, tool use, and agentic workflows. It supports a native context length of up to 1M tokens, and covers more than 200 languages.
